product_description: Brighten your festive space with this vibrant rangoli set featuring pink and yellow pom-poms, golden floral detailing, and elegant lotus tealight holders. Perfect for Diwali, pooja, and traditional home decor.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water and moisture.
Avoid pulling the pom-poms or decorative elements.
Store in a dry box after use.
Use LED tealights for safer decoration.
